pieces.Text:
Anytime a spell targets a flail snail, there is an 80% chance that it produces a random effect instead of affecting the snail. Only spells that directly target the flail snail are warped; area effect spells are not affected. If a spell is warped, roll 1d10 and consult the following table. DESC 
 1-3 Spell misfires. For the next 1d4 rounds, the caster must make a DC 15 concentration check to successfully cast spells. DESC 
 4-6 Spell misfires. The creature nearest the flail snail is affected as if the spell had been cast on it instead. DESC 
 7-9 Spell fails. Nothing happens. DESC 
 10 Spell rebounds on caster (as spell turning).
